title: Weekly Manager Update
bullets: Toni and I have gone over the Board package, and she will be sending out the final version for you tomorrow. Hopefully, this will be a short meeting.
FDOT was here to inspect the culvert that exits the south pond and runs under Seminole Blvd. We were not made aware of any issues.

The pool canopy has been adjusted, and everyone is now happy with the alignment of the roof. The City inspections have begun, and it has cleared all of them so far. They have submitted the progress payment for $13,845. The remainder will be paid once the permit has been closed out.
The generator permit has finally been cleared!
Maintenance has been working on cleaning out gutters at both clubhouses. They have also been pressure washing the sidewalks around them.
The south hot tub was reinspected by the health department and passed.

We received additional information regarding the transformer. Lynntina will complete the design, and then we will be provided with a quote to make a decision prior to moving forward with the replacement.
